name: Cabbage and Kielbasa Skillet
why: One-skillet kielbasa + cabbage, cleanly batch-scalable and all main ingredients (kielbasa, cabbage, onion, carrots) map to the board. Published 435 cal / 14 g carb, mid-band and low-carb. Distinct from existing kielbasa-cabbage-noodles / -potato-skillet / sausage-cabbage-apple (no noodle, potato, or apple here). CONFIDENCE CAVEAT: source protein is only 16 g/serving - below the 25 g high-protein identity target; selector may want to bump the kielbasa ratio at portioning.
